A city known for its skyline. But what happens when you step away from it?
FilterCopy Candid and Hong Kong Tourism Board present Hungry In Hong Kong - Episode 2
Day two takes the challenge beyond Central and into Sai Kung, the coastal side of Hong Kong that most travellers never think about.
From legendary Hong Kong bakery classics like pineapple buns to freshly baked artisan sourdough, from waterfront markets to buzzing kitchens - the chefs once again show two very different ways to experience the city through food.
